He: Attached Proposed Radio Scripts to be Used in Ads Running Prior to the November General Election

Dear Kevin:

In accordance with our telephone discussion yesterday, enclosed please find three sample radio scripts which represent potential radio ads to be employed by an undisclosed client of mins.

I am interested in the Elections Board staff position as to whether these ads constitute "issue advocacy" not subject to regulation by the Wisconsin Elections Board under the U.S. Supreme Court's decision in Buckley and its progeny, or whether staff believes that such ads potentially constitute "express advocacy" subject to regulation by the Elections Board. As I indicated to you on the telephone yesterday, my view is that such ads are "issue advocacy" protected by the Free Speech Clause of the First Amendment and thus not subject to regulation by the Wisconsin Elections Board.

I will await your response, which I understand will be forthcoming by close of business tomorrow, Wednesday, October 2, 1996.

Very truly yours,

MICHAEL, BEST & FRIEDRICH
